run_competitions_app: run the competitions FastAPI app on a specified host and port using uvicorn
create_competition: start a Gradio UI to create a new HuggingFace competition
submit_competition: submit a model or file to a HuggingFace competition via the CLI
check_competitions_version: display the current version of the competitions CLI tool
review_competitions_cli: review the competitions CLI main entry point and registered subcommands
